Built on truth. Built to last.

Wasabi is a skate brand started by two brothers who never lie to each other. That's the whole foundation.

We're building something we can pass down one day, from decks and clothes to skateparks. We give back along the way, and we tell you exactly how it's going.

  • 01Open prices. Ask us where your $70 goes and we'll show you.
  • 02Real people. DM the brand and the guys who drew the deck answer.
  • 03Straight updates. If a batch runs late, you hear it from us first.
  • 04Tithe. 10% of our profit goes to the church.
